verdicts.reason: audit_log_start opens/timestamps audit buffers, audit_log_end queues skbs and wakes kauditd, audit_filter walks ordered rules, and audit_tag_tree tags mount trees.
tracepoint_probe_register/unregister manage probes, unwind_user unwinds user frames, touch_all_softlockup_watchdogs touches allowed CPUs, and log_buf_len_get exposes ring length.
trace_recursion_set, audit_field_valid, and audit_in_mask match, but nbcon_context_try_acquire only shows panic vs console pbufs, not emergency priority preference.
dma_buf attachments/vmaps are protected by resv lock, dma_fence_lock_irqsave uses spin_lock_irqsave, and dev_pm_info/wakeup_source embed spinlocks to serialize fields.

overall: 3 findings are fully supported by the cited fragments and kernel semantics; Finding 3 is partial because nbcon emergency priority order is not shown in nbcon_context_try_acquire.
